reading: Japan had very heavy rain recently.
This rain was "unprecedented", meaning it was very unusual.
Eight people were killed because of the strong rain.
The weather caused a big storm.
This storm cut power to many homes.
Also, 7,000 people were stranded at Narita airport.
They could not leave the airport.
The strong rain made many problems for people.
It shows how dangerous bad weather can be.

vocabulary.definition: Very bad weather with strong wind and rain.
Unable to leave a place because of a problem.
All the people who live together in one house or flat.

entries.ja: これまで一度も起きたことがなく、非常に珍しいこと。
entries.ko: 지금까지 한 번도 일어난 적이 없는, 매우 특이한.
entries.zh-Hans: 从未发生过；非常不寻常。
entries.es: Que nunca antes había sucedido; muy inusual.
entries.pt-BR: Que nunca aconteceu antes; muito incomum.

entries.ja: 強い風と雨を伴う、非常に悪い天気。
entries.ko: 강한 바람과 비를 동반한 아주 나쁜 날씨.
entries.zh-Hans: 伴有强风和大雨的非常恶劣的天气。
entries.es: Clima muy malo con viento y lluvia fuertes.
entries.pt-BR: Tempo muito ruim com vento e chuva fortes.

entries.ja: 電気が機能するのを止めた。
entries.es: Hizo que la electricidad dejara de funcionar.

entries.ja: 問題のためにある場所を離れることができない状態。
entries.ko: 문제 때문에 어떤 장소를 떠날 수 없는.
entries.zh-Hans: 由于某个问题而无法离开某地。
entries.es: Imposibilitado de abandonar un lugar debido a un problema.
entries.pt-BR: Incapaz de sair de um lugar por causa de um problema.

entries.ja: 一つの家やアパートに一緒に住んでいる全ての人々。
entries.ko: 한 집이나 아파트에 함께 사는 모든 사람.
entries.zh-Hans: 所有住在一个房子或公寓里的人。
entries.es: Todas las personas que viven juntas en una casa o piso.
entries.pt-BR: Todas as pessoas que vivem juntas em uma casa ou apartamento.
